items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: So we were there for a year and we got to meet everybody who came through The Sands. Now that’s Sinatra, Nat King Cole, Jerry Lewis, on and on and on. Sammy Davis.
